sources.entry: Tautulli | Monitoring and statistics for Plex Media Server

summary.one_liner: Tautulli is a Python web application that monitors, analyzes, and sends notifications about Plex Media Server activity.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Python web app for monitoring Plex Media Server, with analytics and notifications. It lists a responsive web interface, live monitoring of current Plex server activity, and customizable notifications for stream activity and recently added media. Home-page statistics can be set to a configurable duration and metric. It also provides a searchable, sortable global watching history, a user list with comparison stats, and per-user details including device IP addresses. Library statistics, media file information, content info pages, and Highcharts-based graphs are included. The README says it is based on code from Headphones and PlexWatchWeb.
use_cases: monitor who is streaming from Plex
view Plex watch history and statistics
send notifications for Plex stream or new media activity
track per-user Plex viewing and devices
how_to_run: Read the Installation Guides linked from the README (installation instructions are on the project wiki)
notable: Monitors current Plex Media Server activity and watch history with search and sorting
Configurable notifications for stream activity and recently added media
Per-user pages showing devices and IP addresses
Runs without a separate web server, per the README's easy-setup claim
caveats: Installation steps are not included in the README; it points to external installation guides
Highsoft libraries are free only for non-commercial use; commercial users must license them
